info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Rules-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Rules API provides a comprehensive view of the loyalty points rules applicable for various hotel programs. Typically used by hotel chain developers and loyalty program managers, this endpoint allows clients to retrieve the specific rules governing the accumulation and redemption of loyalty points. By accessing this data, businesses can ensure their systems are aligned with the latest regulations and offerings. This API is essential for integrating loyalty programs into customer platforms, thereby enhancing user engagement and satisfaction.

get.description: Fetches the current rules and regulations governing point allocations. This endpoint provides the necessary information for users to understand how points are earned, lost, and redeemed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch the rules related to points. It allows clients to specify parameters for retrieving the desired information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the rules for points.
